newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico crude port Pajaritos reopened - port.
newsitem.headline: Mexico crude port Pajaritos reopened - port.

text.p: Mexico crude port Pajaritos in Veracruz state reopened at 1300 local/1900 GMT on Monday, leaving all of the nation's main crude ports open, a port official told Reuters.
The port had closed at 1515 local/2115 GMT on Saturday as a cold front raised wind speeds in the Gulf of Mexico.

Dos Bocas in Tabasco state also closed on Saturday, and reopened at 0800 local/1400 GMT. The third of Mexico's main crude ports, Cayo Arcas in Campeche state, remained open during the weekend's bad weather.

Mexico state oil and gas monopoly Petroleos Mexicanos (Pemex) latest figures said Pajaritos ships an average 399,000 barrels per day (bpd) of crude, Dos Bocas ships about 440,000 bpd and Cayo Arcas ships 611,000 bpd.
